groups.activation: profile, governance, or any guardian output
groups.rationale: Keep project facts, accepted risk, and capability applicability honest.

groups.activation: web control plane or public/generated API enabled or observed
groups.rationale: Keep one portable control-plane contract and safe request boundary.

groups.activation: Flutter enabled or observed
groups.rationale: Keep delegated mobile identity, wire contracts, local secrets, push, and links safe.

groups.activation: the corresponding authenticated, delegated, service, enterprise, or support access exists
groups.rationale: Bind identity and authorization to current durable project state.

groups.activation: shared-schema multi-tenancy enabled or tenant context observed
groups.verification: SQL static analysis and negative runtime tests
groups.rationale: Prevent cross-tenant access through keys, policies, roles, and privileged paths.

groups.activation: agent authoring/publication enabled or observed
groups.verification: compiler determinism, schema, eval and publication tests
groups.rationale: Make published agent behavior immutable, pinned and reviewable.

groups.activation: agents, agent admission, jobs, retried effects, or shared tenant Workflow World as specified
groups.rationale: Give each durable state class one owner and qualify recovery, tenancy, and engine exit safely.

groups.activation: connector, MCP or webhook enabled or observed
groups.rationale: Constrain external capabilities, identity and side effects at the trust boundary.

groups.activation: untrusted execution or sandbox enabled or observed
groups.rationale: Keep untrusted execution disposable, credential-free and policy-brokered.

groups.activation: corresponding business, knowledge, memory, object, or lifecycle data exists
groups.verification: schema, authorization, deletion, object security and recovery tests
groups.rationale: Keep authoritative data, derived state and lifecycle ownership explicit.

groups.activation: corresponding realtime, channel, or notification capability exists
groups.verification: protocol, ingress, reconnect, dedupe and delivery tests
groups.rationale: Separate ephemeral transport from durable event and notification ownership.

groups.activation: model routing or BYOK enabled or observed
groups.verification: route policy, credential and fallback integration
groups.rationale: Preserve tenant, region, retention and key-source policy across model routes.

groups.activation: telemetry or audit surface exists
groups.rationale: Provide useful evidence without leaking sensitive content.

groups.activation: the corresponding exposed capability, secret, authorization, build or abuse surface exists
groups.rationale: Enforce security in typed/runtime boundaries rather than prompts or assumptions.

groups.activation: corresponding owned deployable/provider boundary exists
groups.verification: source graph, bundle and runtime qualification
groups.rationale: Keep runtimes inside supported ownership and trust boundaries.

groups.activation: package graph, generated contract, version family, or production deployable exists
groups.rationale: Keep packages directed, production graphs verified, and protocol families atomically qualified.

groups.activation: production deployable uses the corresponding hosting profile
groups.rationale: Make runtime placement and provider limitations explicit.

groups.activation: applicable production objective, durable data, region/cell, or incident surface exists
groups.verification: declared objective and live recovery/incident drill
groups.rationale: Tie architecture to measured service and recovery behavior.

groups.activation: corresponding enabled capability, migration, release, source decision, or environment test exists
groups.verification: CI, migration, release and evidence checks
groups.rationale: Deliver changes compatibly and report only evidence actually reproduced.

groups.activation: agents, prompts, or model-backed behavior shipped to users
groups.verification: eval regression, dataset versioning, sampling policy review
groups.rationale: Gate agent, prompt, and model changes on reproduced evaluation evidence.

groups.activation: external model providers enabled or observed
groups.verification: route policy, deprecation tracking, canary and pressure qualification
groups.rationale: Keep model choice explicit and migratable and behavior stable under provider change and load.

groups.activation: metered AI, sandbox, or knowledge-processing resources exist
groups.rationale: Treat AI spend as an owned architectural resource with attribution, budgets, and deploy gates.

groups.activation: personal data, knowledge ingestion, external model calls, or public AI output exists
groups.rationale: Keep personal data and untrusted content controlled across AI trust boundaries.
